item.title: Siri AI Hands On: A Smart, Helpful Assistant
item.description: The new Siri AI is conversational, omnipresent, and actually helpful.

item.title: How the Peter Thiel-Linked Dialog Club Secretly Ranks Its Members
item.description: Leaked files show the invite-only network grades members by their money and fame, shaping who’s in, who’s out, and who pays.

item.title: The White House Is Making Up Its Rules for AI in Real Time
item.description: Anthropic still can’t distribute Claude Mythos or Fable 5 after running afoul of the Trump administration. But no one can say exactly what the company did wrong.

item.title: Meta’s AI Workers Are Revolting, Peter Thiel’s Secret Society, and SBF’s Plea to Trump
item.description: On today’s Uncanny Valley, we dive into the dysfunction in Meta’s newly formed AI unit and why it’s been driving already-low employee morale even further into the ground.

item.title: 3 Amazon Workers Say They’re Under Investigation for Speaking Out About Data Centers
item.description: The software engineers filed a complaint with Seattle’s civil rights office accusing Amazon of illegally retaliating against them for expressing their personal political beliefs.

item.title: The UK Will Scan Asylum-Seekers’ Faces for Age Checks—Despite Knowing the Tech Is Flawed
item.description: Internal Home Office tests of age-verification technology show the risks of life-altering errors. It’s moving forward anyway.

item.title: The Korean Telecom Giant at the Center of Anthropic’s Mythos Controversy
item.description: Days before Anthropic took its most advanced AI models offline, the White House ordered the company to revoke SK Telecom’s access to Claude Mythos over claims of alleged ties to China.

item.title: Operating a Humanoid With Your Body Is a Hot Job in China’s Hardware Capital
item.description: In Shenzhen, workers at IO-AI Tech control humanoid robots using a VR rig reminiscent of Ready Player One.

item.title: The White House Wants Anthropic to Block All Jailbreaks. That May Not Be Possible
item.description: Trump administration officials tell WIRED that if Anthropic wants to rerelease Fable 5, it will need to ensure the model's guardrails can't be circumvented. Security experts say that can't be done.

item.title: The Gemini-Powered Google Home Speaker Is Finally Here
item.description: Arriving six years after Google’s last smart speaker, the new HomePod-style device was redesigned to play host to Gemini’s chatbot.
